_help: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. See README.md for where each value comes from.
_setup_help: laptop_only = only 'turn off' works, no extra hardware. with_bridge = 'turn on' works too, needs an always-on device running the bridge.
_off_action_help: shutdown, sleep or hibernate. Sleep is the easiest to wake up from with Wake-on-LAN, especially over Wi-Fi.
_with_bridge_help: Only for with_bridge. laptop_mac and laptop_ip come from 'ipconfig /all' on the laptop. Put the same agent_token (any random text, 16+ characters) in the config.json on both the laptop and the bridge.
